newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Hunan cement maker to offer 150 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: China Hunan cement maker to offer 150 mln B shares.

text.p: China's Hunan Shaofeng Cement Co Ltd plans to offer 150 million B shares and list them on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange this year, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

If successful, the firm would use the proceeds to improve production technology and buy cement loading and unloading equipment, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

Based in the city of Xiangxiang in central Hunan province, the firm is among the 33 domestic companies named on Tuesday by the Securities Commission of the State Council as B share listing candidates.
The official said the company forecast cement output of 2.02 million tonnes for 1997, compared with 1.15 million last year.
All of Shaofeng's cement was marketed in mainland China in 1996, with 60 percent sold to Guangzhou and Shenzhen and the remaining 40 percent in Hunan province, he said.
The company's total share capital is not yet fixed because its assets are being restructured, the spokesman said.
